title: Schedule
description: Commits the agreed time window for the order — a single [start, end) interval that expresses an appointment, a booked timeslot, or a rental period equally (one representation, the parties agree its meaning). The window is a transaction particular: it fills at checkout, never at design time. Duration is DERIVED, never stored — a rate-priced catalogue item derives its billed hours from this window at the pricing site (windowEnd − windowStart); there is no separate hours field to keep in sync. This clause records only the AGREED window; the ACTUAL start/finish is a runtime attestation on the relevant process clause (the sovereign event log), and any return or hand-off leg is a second co-equal order, never encoded here. windowEnd must be after windowStart — checked off-chain at read time, never on chain.

fields.name: windowStart
fields.label: Start
fields.description: Start of the agreed window (ISO 8601 date-time). The instant the booking, appointment, or rental period begins.

fields.name: windowEnd
fields.label: End
fields.description: End of the agreed window (ISO 8601 date-time). Must be after windowStart. Billed hours are derived as windowEnd − windowStart at the pricing site, never stored here.
